items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: he was the second trumpet player... when we were rehearsing... we were rehearsing to go into the recording studio

ctx.x: Mm hum. Was that music that you were playing with that group something that you guys learned by ear? Or were there charts?

Well it’s funny you should say that because when we were rehearsing, we were rehearsing to go into the recording studio then go on the road, so there was a record attached to this Buddy Miles thing. When we went into the studio, and this guy named Richard Griffin — Richard Griffith, and his, they called him “Cush.” And he was this really cool guy man and he was quite a bit older than me, and he was the second trumpet player. He used to play with Parliament Funkadelic and he’s on some of the recordings even,…
We were talking about charts or playing by ear.
